contexts.text: To sew the leaf together = to excuse.
The ignorance and simplicity excuses; because there may be innocence in them.
That those who are in internal worship and in external worship thence, interpret such things into good, and excuse. Treated of. AC 1085. AC 1087.
They who are in the faith of charity... observe goods, and if they see evils and falsities, they excuse them... Treated of.
The Angels excuse the things which are evil and false.
That human rational truth wanted to excuse itself. Signified.
If good Spirits should speak evilly or do evil, they are... excused, because their end was not to do so; and they know that such things are excited with them by Hell...
Those (men of the Church) who are like the Angels... if they see evil in anyone, excuse it.
Evil Spirits excite falsities and evils; and the Angels excuse if the end has been good...
He does not pray the Father for them... but He continually excuses...
The rich people who were called to the great supper, and excused themselves = the Jewish nation.
Afterwards... from the delight of love, he excuses these evils... and calls them allowable...
They who make faith alone saving, excuse a life of evil. References.
Ignorance does indeed excuse; but it does not take away confirmed falsity...
That (marriage semblances) are for the sake of excuses of blemishes.
I have heard excuses made by these women...
There are various circumstances... which mitigate and excuse crimes...
They in whom good reigns... excuse.
Unless ignorance excused, it would be all over with man.
They excused; they were good...
They close Heaven against themselves by this, that they excuse evil works; which they excuse by this, that they say and believe that evils are not seen by God...
Occurs. LJPost 299. CanonsNC 46. Trinity. 9. 8.
